finding.text: `ai-api.md` is not linked from the core/Page readme or the Servex agents readme, and the brief asks for both. `git grep ai-api` on branch worktree/page-ai-api finds no hit in `public/framework/core/Page/readme.md`, `Servex/agents/readme.md` or `Servex/readme.md`.

The "Live proof" requirement is not met yet: the fresh-Haiku run that uses only the tool descriptions has not happened, and `ai-api.md:726-728` says so. The headless timings (39/12/14 ms) come from the builder's own probe, not from a model choosing its own deltas.

`Subpages.rename` and `Subpages.remove` never run `check_name` on `name` (Subpages.js:55-57, 72-73). So `page_set({"pages":{"remove":"../other-page"}})` moves a sibling page into `_removed/`. Validate `name` the same way `to` is validated.
There are no 400/1200/1920/3440 layout shots or smoke results in the task folder. `build/` holds only `session.png` and `notes.png`, so the layout-check item is unproven.
The `page_call`, `page_add` and `page_log` lines in page_tools.js (diff lines 274, 287, 349) have an extra indent level. Cosmetic only.

In the `ai-api.md` table, "call any method" uses `{"q1":{"answer":"42"}}` as its example, but `answer` is a property. That clashes with the doc's own rule ("a key naming a method calls it"). Use a real method in the example, e.g. `{"q1":{"answers":{"add":{…}}}}`.

`create_page` (Servex/pages.js:510) now goes through `Subpages.add`, which builds line 1 with `...more`. Any extra argument a caller passes ends up in line 1. That is harmless today, because the call passes only named fields.

Simpler-way check: folding `pages` into `page_set` and keeping the old names as aliases is the smallest design that covers the brief's table. The session-only `AISessionDetail.Parts` duplicates what a Page content list does (CLAUDE.md law 6). `ai-api.md` already justifies this by the `Page.class.js` freeze, so it should become a follow-up once the split plan lands.
